projectDescription: A single-file landing page for Baseline, a members' tennis club and academy, built with zero build tooling — pure HTML, inline CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
keyFeatures: Zero build tooling — single HTML file with inline CSS and vanilla JS
Hand-rolled spring animation engine (mkSpring) for smooth UI transitions
Lenis smooth scroll via CDN import map — no npm install required
Fluid type scale using viewport-relative root font-size breakpoints
Accessible mobile menu overlay (role=dialog, aria-modal, inert background)
Book a Visit modal with form and spring-animated open/close
Coach carousel and collection slider with dot navigation
publicApiSurface: mkSpring(el, from, to, cfg, apply) — create a spring-driven animator
Spring.to(target) — animate to a target state
wordClips(el, text, opts) — wrap words in clip spans for reveal animations
playClips(nodes, opts) — trigger staggered word-clip reveal
stackedLines(el, lines, opts) — build stacked line nodes for heading reveals
playStacked(el) — play all stacked-line heading reveals on an element
hover(trigger, el, from, to, cfg, apply) — attach spring hover interaction
addParallax(el, from, to, unit, section) — register a parallax scroll item
openMenu() / closeMenu() — control mobile menu overlay
openModal() / closeModal() — control Book a Visit modal
setSlide(i) — navigate collection slider to index i
setTrust(i) — navigate coach carousel to index i
